title: AuditEvent::to_json expect panics in production
description: crates/core/src/audit.rs: AuditEvent::to_json calls serde_json::to_string(...).expect("audit event must serialize"). serde_json serialization is infallible for types with no custom Serializer, but the expect makes it a logic bomb if any AuditEvent field ever becomes non-serializable. Fix: return Result<String, serde_json::Error> from to_json and propagate at the call site, or use unwrap_or_else with a fallback JSON string.
